reason_text.FAILED_TEST: a citing test case of this component FAILED in the run
reason_text.NO_METHOD: the SDD row names no recognisable verification method
reason_text.AMBIGUOUS_ID: the same requirement ID is defined more than once
reason_text.CITED_UNDER_DIFFERENT_ID: a test of this component cites an undefined ID ending in this one
reason_text.CITED_BY_OTHER_COMPONENT: only tests of another component cite it
reason_text.NO_CITING_TEST: no test case cites it with REQUIREMENT("ID")
reason_text.NOT_EXECUTED: a citing test case did not run in the loaded run
reason_text.EVIDENCE_OUTSIDE_REPO: a declared method (e.g. Inspection) leaves no record in the repository

verdicts:
CALL {
  MATCH (x:Requirement)
  WITH split(x.id, '@')[0] AS ref, count(*) AS n WHERE n > 1
  RETURN collect(ref) AS dup_refs
}
MATCH (p:Part)-[:SATISFIES]->(r:Requirement)
WITH dup_refs, p, r, split(r.id, '@')[0] AS ref
OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:VERIFIED_BY]->(v:Verification)
WITH dup_refs, p, r, ref, collect(DISTINCT v.method) AS methods
OPTIONAL MATCH (r)<-[:CITES]-(cite_site)-[:TESTS]->(site_part:Part)
OPTIONAL MATCH (tc:TestCase)-[:TESTS]->(site_part)
  WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (tc)-[:CALLS*0..8]->(cite_site) }
WITH dup_refs, p, r, ref, methods, collect(DISTINCT tc) AS citing
UNWIND CASE WHEN size(citing) = 0 THEN [null] ELSE citing END AS tc
OPTIONAL MATCH (tc)-[:TESTS]->(tp:Part)
OPTIONAL MATCH (tc)-[ran:RAN_IN]->(:TestRun {id: $run})
WITH dup_refs, p, r, ref, methods,
     collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN tc IS NULL THEN null
             ELSE {id: tc.id, own: tp = p, status: coalesce(ran.status, 'NOT_RUN')} END) AS cites
OPTIONAL MATCH (site)-[:TESTS]->(p)
  WHERE (site:TestCase OR site:TestFunction)
    AND any(u IN site.unknown_citations WHERE u <> ref AND (u ENDS WITH '-' + ref OR u ENDS WITH '_' + ref))
OPTIONAL MATCH (dt:TestCase)-[:TESTS]->(p)
  WHERE site IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS { MATCH (dt)-[:CALLS*0..8]->(site) }
WITH dup_refs, p, r, ref, methods, cites, collect(DISTINCT dt.id) AS drift
WITH p, r, ref, methods, drift, ref IN dup_refs AS ambiguous,
     [c IN cites WHERE c.own] AS own, [c IN cites WHERE NOT c.own] AS other
WITH p, r, methods, drift, ambiguous, own, other,
     [c IN own WHERE c.status = 'FAILED'] AS failed,
     [c IN own WHERE c.status IN ['NOT_RUN', 'SKIPPED']] AS not_run,
     [m IN methods WHERE NOT m IN $test_methods] AS outside
WITH p, r, methods, drift, own, other, failed, [x IN [
       CASE WHEN size(methods) = 0 THEN 'NO_METHOD' END,
       CASE WHEN ambiguous THEN 'AMBIGUOUS_ID' END,
       CASE WHEN size(own) = 0 AND size(drift) > 0 THEN 'CITED_UNDER_DIFFERENT_ID' END,
       CASE WHEN size(own) = 0 AND size(drift) = 0 AND size(other) > 0 THEN 'CITED_BY_OTHER_COMPONENT' END,
       CASE WHEN size(own) = 0 AND size(drift) = 0 AND size(other) = 0 THEN 'NO_CITING_TEST' END,
       CASE WHEN size(failed) = 0 AND size(not_run) > 0 THEN 'NOT_EXECUTED' END,
       CASE WHEN size(outside) > 0 AND NOT ($accept_declared AND size(own) > 0) THEN 'EVIDENCE_OUTSIDE_REPO' END
     ] WHERE x IS NOT NULL] AS reasons
RETURN r.id AS id, p.id AS component, r.text AS text, r.source AS source, methods,
       CASE WHEN size(failed) > 0 THEN 'NO-GO' WHEN size(reasons) = 0 THEN 'GO' ELSE 'INCOMPLETE' END AS verdict,
       CASE WHEN size(failed) > 0 THEN ['FAILED_TEST'] + reasons ELSE reasons END AS reasons,
       [c IN own | c.id + ' ' + c.status] AS own_tests,
       [c IN other | c.id + ' ' + c.status] AS other_tests,
       drift AS drift_tests
ORDER BY component, id
tests_to_rerun:
MATCH (s:Part)
CALL {
  WITH s
  MATCH (h) WHERE h.id IN $ripple AND h <> s
  MATCH chain = shortestPath((s)-[:INCLUDES*1..12]->(h))
  RETURN collect(chain) AS chains
}
WITH s, chains, EXISTS { MATCH (s)-[:USES_PORT]->(pt:PortType) WHERE pt.id IN $port_types } AS uses_changed_port
WHERE s.id IN $components OR uses_changed_port OR size(chains) > 0 OR $everywhere
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[u:USES_PORT]->(pt2:PortType) WHERE pt2.id IN $port_types
WITH s, chains, collect(DISTINCT pt2.id + ' as ' + u.port) AS via_ports
OPTIONAL MATCH (tc:TestCase)-[:TESTS]->(s)
WITH s, chains, via_ports, collect(tc.gtest_filter) AS filters
OPTIONAL MATCH (s)-[:SATISFIES]->(r:Requirement)
RETURN s.id AS component, s.id IN $components AS changed_directly, via_ports, size(chains) > 0 AS via_includes,
       CASE WHEN size(chains) > 0 THEN [n IN nodes(chains[0]) | n.id] ELSE [] END AS include_chain,
       size(filters) AS test_cases, filters, collect(r.id) AS requirements
ORDER BY changed_directly DESC, component
integration:
MATCH (i:Instance)-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(p:Part) WHERE p.id IN $components
MATCH (i)-[c:CONNECTS_TO]-(o:Instance)
RETURN i.id AS instance, CASE WHEN startNode(c) = i THEN 'out' ELSE 'in' END AS direction,
       o.id AS peer, c.src_port AS src_port, c.dst_port AS dst_port, c.graph AS graph
ORDER BY instance, direction, peer
evidence_paths:
MATCH (r:Requirement {id: $id})<-[:CITES]-(cite_site)-[:TESTS]->(site_part:Part)
MATCH (tc:TestCase)-[:TESTS]->(site_part)
MATCH path = shortestPath((tc)-[:CALLS*0..8]->(cite_site))
OPTIONAL MATCH (tc)-[ran:RAN_IN]->(:TestRun {id: $run})
WITH tc, ran, path ORDER BY length(path)
WITH tc, ran, collect(path)[0] AS shortest
RETURN tc.id AS test_case, coalesce(ran.status, 'NOT_RUN') AS status,
       [n IN nodes(shortest) | coalesce(n.name, n.gtest_filter, n.id)] AS chain, length(shortest) AS calls
ORDER BY test_case
drift_path:
MATCH (tc:TestCase {id: $test_case})-[:CALLS*0..8]->(site)
WHERE any(u IN site.unknown_citations WHERE u <> $ref AND (u ENDS WITH '-' + $ref OR u ENDS WITH '_' + $ref))
WITH tc, site LIMIT 1
MATCH path = shortestPath((tc)-[:CALLS*0..8]->(site))
RETURN [n IN nodes(path) | coalesce(n.name, n.id)] AS chain,
       [u IN site.unknown_citations WHERE u ENDS WITH '-' + $ref OR u ENDS WITH '_' + $ref][0] AS cited

fp_unknown_citations.title: Test files citing requirement IDs that no SDD defines
fp_unknown_citations.cypher: MATCH (t:TestFile) WHERE size(t.unknown_citations) > 0 OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:TESTS]->(p:Part) RETURN t.id AS file, p.id AS component, t.unknown_citations AS unknown_ids ORDER BY file

fp_duplicate_requirement_ids.title: Requirement IDs defined more than once
fp_duplicate_requirement_ids.cypher: MATCH (r:Requirement) WITH split(r.id, '@')[0] AS ref, collect(r) AS rs WHERE size(rs) > 1 UNWIND rs AS r RETURN ref AS id, r.component AS component, r.source AS source ORDER BY id, source

fp_cross_component_citations.title: Requirements cited by unit tests of another component
fp_cross_component_citations.cypher: MATCH (p:Part)-[:SATISFIES]->(r:Requirement)<-[:CITES]-(cite_site)-[:TESTS]->(q:Part) WHERE p <> q MATCH (tc:TestCase)-[:TESTS]->(q) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (tc)-[:CALLS*0..8]->(cite_site) } RETURN r.id AS id, p.id AS owner, q.id AS cited_by, count(DISTINCT tc) AS test_cases ORDER BY id, cited_by

unverified_requirements.title: Requirements whose SDD row names no verification method
unverified_requirements.cypher: MATCH (p:Part)-[:SATISFIES]->(r:Requirement) WHERE NOT (r)-[:VERIFIED_BY]->() RETURN r.id AS id, p.id AS component, r.methods_raw AS declared ORDER BY component, id

fp_components_without_requirements.title: Components in the Ref deployment whose directory has no SDD requirements
fp_components_without_requirements.cypher: MATCH (i:Instance)-[:INSTANCE_OF]->(p:Part) WHERE NOT (p)-[:SATISFIES]->(:Requirement) RETURN p.id AS id, collect(i.name) AS instances, p.has_sdd AS has_sdd ORDER BY id

fp_requirement_evidence.title: Test cases citing one requirement
fp_requirement_evidence.cypher: MATCH (p:Part)-[:SATISFIES]->(r:Requirement {id: $id}) OPTIONAL MATCH (r)<-[:CITES]-(cite_site)-[:TESTS]->(q:Part) OPTIONAL MATCH (tc:TestCase)-[:TESTS]->(q) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (tc)-[:CALLS*0..8]->(cite_site) } RETURN r.id AS requirement, p.id AS component, r.text AS text, r.methods_raw AS declared, r.source AS source, collect(tc.id) AS test_cases, collect(DISTINCT q.id) AS tested_by_components

fp_part_requirements.title: Requirements of one component and the test cases citing them
fp_part_requirements.cypher: MATCH (p:Part {id: $id})-[:SATISFIES]->(r:Requirement) OPTIONAL MATCH (r)<-[:CITES]-(cite_site)-[:TESTS]->(p) OPTIONAL MATCH (tc:TestCase)-[:TESTS]->(p) WHERE cite_site IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS { MATCH (tc)-[:CALLS*0..8]->(cite_site) } RETURN r.id AS id, r.methods AS methods, collect(DISTINCT tc.gtest_filter) AS cited_by ORDER BY id

fp_port_type_users.title: Components using one port type
fp_port_type_users.cypher: MATCH (p:Part)-[u:USES_PORT]->(t:PortType {id: $id}) RETURN p.id AS id, u.port AS port, u.direction AS direction, u.kind AS kind ORDER BY id, port

fp_instance_neighbours.title: Port connections of one Ref deployment instance (integration view)
fp_instance_neighbours.cypher: MATCH (i:Instance {id: $id})-[c:CONNECTS_TO]-(o:Instance) RETURN o.id AS id, CASE WHEN startNode(c) = i THEN 'out' ELSE 'in' END AS direction, c.src_port AS src_port, c.dst_port AS dst_port, c.graph AS graph ORDER BY direction, id

fp_part_by_type.title: Component directory for an FPP type name
fp_part_by_type.cypher: MATCH (p:Part) WHERE $type IN p.types RETURN p.id AS id

describe.title: Neighbourhood of one entity
describe.cypher: MATCH (n:Entity {id: $id}) OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[rel]-(m:Entity) RETURN n.id AS node, n.text AS text, type(rel) AS rel, CASE WHEN startNode(rel) = n THEN 'out' ELSE 'in' END AS direction, m.id AS id ORDER BY rel, id LIMIT 200

fulltext_search.title: Full-text matches (Relate full-text index)
fulltext_search.cypher: CALL db.index.fulltext.queryNodes('entity_text', $text) YIELD node, score RETURN node.id AS id, [l IN labels(node) WHERE l <> 'Entity'][0] AS label, score, node.text AS text ORDER BY score DESC, id LIMIT $k
